payout_quote: If you become a 'qualified' Referrer or 'qualified' Referee, then you can choose a stock or ETF of your choice from a selection of available stocks and/or ETF's and receive a notional value of $20 of this asset (your 'Reward')... The Referee (i) uses the Referrer's unique link to open a brokerage account with Public Investing, (ii) is approved by Public Investing for this brokerage account, and (iii) successfully deposits at least $1,000 as an initial onetime deposit into this brokerage account... You have 30 days to claim your Reward... The cash value of the Reward received through this Referral Program may not be withdrawn for 12 months after it is claimed or else your brokerage account may be subject to an early withdrawal fee of up to $20. (Official Public Referral Program Terms & Conditions)
timing: Reward claimable after qualification; cash value locked 12 months from claim
eligibility: Referrer must be an existing Public Investing member with a funded account in good standing; referee must be a personal friend/family member with a direct relationship, no existing Public account, and deposit $1,000 as a one-time initial deposit
steps: Open and fund your own Public Investing brokerage account
Share your unique referral link with a friend or family member
They open an account via your link, get approved, and make a $1,000 one-time initial deposit
Both of you claim the $20 stock/ETF reward within 30 days
Reward value is locked for 12 months before the cash can be withdrawn
catches: HIGH BAR: the friend must deposit $1,000 as a one-time initial deposit - most casual referrals won't qualify
The $20 reward is LOCKED for 12 months - withdrawing early triggers a fee of up to $20 (wiping out the reward)
You have only 30 days to claim the reward or it expires forever
Referee must be someone you have a direct personal relationship with - no mass-posting to strangers
Referrer needs a funded account in good standing first
biggest_catch: Your friend must drop $1,000 in one deposit, and the $20 reward is locked for 12 months - cash out early and the fee eats the entire reward.
